thread:
jess (AE): Heads-up — Acme Payments wants a POC for Private/on-prem install. They are air-gapped-ish and asking what we need from them: GPU drivers, CUDA, k8s versions, networking, KMS, registry access. Can eng-infra + SE help compile a short pre-check checklist we can hand to their SRE?

omar (SE): Are we doing full private (on-prem in their DC) or VPC-in-customer-account?

jess (AE): Full on-prem. They prefer no outbound except to a few endpoints if possible, otherwise we’ll do an offline bundle.

liam (eng-infra): Quick checklist draft (high level):
- NVIDIA driver: >= 525 recommended (H100/A100/A10 tested). Verify with `nvidia-smi`.
- CUDA: 11.8 or 12.x (compatible with our runtime).
- nvidia-container-toolkit or NVIDIA GPU Operator installed.
- Container runtime: `containerd` (>=1.5) or Docker legacy with CRI shim.
- Kubernetes: supported 1.24 - 1.27 (installer v2.3 prefers 1.25+). Disable swap, ensure kubelet flags are standard.
- Kernel: 5.15+ recommended.
- kubelet device plugin (NVIDIA) enabled and GPUs show up in `kubectl describe nodes`.
- Node labeling: label GPU nodes `redwood/gpu=true` for scheduling.
- Storage: PV for model cache (recommend 100-200Gi). Fast NVMe recommended for model load times.
- RBAC: service account with permissions for creating pods/CRs, plus secrets read for registry/KMS mounts.
- Network: outbound to our control plane (if not fully air-gapped) — `control.redwood.ai:443` plus optional metrics endpoints and KMS endpoints.
- TLS: cluster CA and certs for the private registry and ingress.
- Registry: private registry or local mirror; images can be pre-pulled.
- KMS/HSM: integration via PKCS#11 or cloud KMS endpoints. Ensure reachable or provide key material for offline mode.

liam (eng-infra): Quick commands for their SRE to run and paste results:
```
# GPU and driver
nvidia-smi
# CUDA check (if nvcc installed)
nvcc --version || echo "nvcc not present"
# K8s nodes and labels
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get nodes --show-labels | grep redwood || true
# check container runtime
crictl info | grep -i runtime
# storage
kubectl get pv,pvc -o wide
# network egress test (from a cluster pod)
kubectl run -i --rm tmp --image=alpine --restart=Never -- sh -c "apk add --no-cache curl && curl -v https://control.redwood.ai:443 || true"
```

katie (Acme SRE): For air-gapped we will not allow any outbound to 3rd-party. How big is the offline bundle and can you provide a pre-download checklist?

omar (SE): We support an offline bundle; it contains images, helm charts, runtime binaries, and cert templates. Size depends on model cache we include — usually 5-30GB for runtime + base models; add model artifacts if they want a seeded cache.

liam (eng-infra): For offline installs we need:
- local registry or registry mirror on premise
- pre-pulled images tarball (we can provide)
- helm chart and values.yaml with local paths
- KMS key-handling instructions (if they can't reach our KMS, they must supply a wrapped key or HSM access)

liam (eng-infra): Also notes on resource sizing:
- Small POC (1-2 GPUs): 1 control-plane node + 1 GPU worker (A10/A100).
- Production sizing depends on concurrency: each GPU can serve multiple streams with batching; plan for 32-64GB GPU memory for larger models.

deploy-bot: Installer v2.3 released — requires k8s >=1.25. See release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2.3 (internal). :package:

omar (SE): I'll turn this into a one-page pre-check and a small bash script that runs the commands and uploads output (anonymized) to our secure intake S3. katie — can you run the script and send the bundle?

katie (Acme SRE): Yep, will run Monday. One question: what ports need to be open if we allow minimal outbound?

liam (eng-infra): Minimal outbound: 443 to `control.redwood.ai` (TLS) and 443 to KMS provider endpoints (depends on their KMS). For NTP/time sync allow UDP/123. For registries allow HTTP(S) to the mirror host. If fully offline, none required but we need pre-bundled images and keys.

jess (AE): Awesome — thanks team. Omar, can you have the one-pager + script by EOD? I'll attach to the customer ticket and loop in Acme legal for the KMS/HSM questions. :thumbsup:

omar (SE): On it. Will ping once PR is up.
